Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IndlM Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

SPECIAL PURPOSE SYRINGES 

PART 5 POST OPERATION CARE SYRINGE 

( Second Revision ) 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1 . Scope — Covert requirements for post operstion care syringes for medical use. 

1.1 For general requirements, the provisions covered In IS : 3235-1980 'General requirements for 
syringes for medical use {firsi revision )' shall apply unless otherwise stated in this standard. 

2. Sizes end Dimeneione of Syringes 

2A Except the frontal and nozzle portion typical syringe shall be as shown In Fig. 1 A of 
IS : 3236-1 980 'Specification for hypodermic syringes for general purposes ( firsi revision )'. 

2.2 The capacities of syringes shall be 30 ml and 50 ml in accordance with Table 1 of IS : 3236*1980. 

2.3 The sub-divisions or scale intervals, length of scale, the minimum length of the graduation and the 
numbering of the graduation shall be In accordance with 3.3 and 3.4 with Table 1 of IS : 3236-1980. 

2A Dimensions of syringes shall be In accordance with 3.5 read with Table 2 of IS : 3236-1980, 
except the following: 

Meximum Lengtii Diameter of Effluent 

210 mm for 30 ml 32 ± 02 mm 

230 mm for 50 ml 7 9 ± 1 mm 

3. Requirements 

3.1 Nozzle — The glass nozzle shall be In accordance with the dimensions shown In Fig. 1.

3.2 The numbering of scale intervals shall be in accordance with col 6 of Table 1 of IS : 3236*1980. 
The number shall be close to, but shall not touch the ends of the graduation mark to which it relates. 
The numbering shall generally confirm to the details given in Fig. 3 of IS : 3236-1980. The numbers 
shall be clearly defined, durable and easily legible. 

3.3 The piston shall be easily visible through the barrel and the fiducial line shall be capable of being 
judged against the graduations very accurately. 

4« Tests 

4.1 Ail tests given in IS : 3235-1980 shall apply except 8.1 and 8.2. 

5. Marking — Each syringe shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the following : 

a) Manufacturer's name. Initials or recognized trade-mark; 

b) Unit of capacity, mi; and 

c) Means of identification of barrel and piston. 

6.1 Certfflcation Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

6. Packing — Shall be as agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of J^e series of special purpose syringes and includes the requirements of 
post operation care syringes.^^
